dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Emilio Pooch is at risk due to medical reasons. Emilio Pooch is a friendly, easily handlead geriatric male with a heart murmur and elevated proBNP, severe dental disease, and a suspected healed elbow fracture. He has developed CIRDC in the shelter, but is still eating wet food very well. He will need ongoing supportive care to maintain his appetite and a quiet environment to recover. Despite his age and chronic medical concerns, Emilio Pooch appears likely to have a good quality of life outside of the shelter where he can enjoy his golden years.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I can go home today!

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I have medical needs that staff will address with you when you meet me.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I'm sensitive and shy. I'll need extra help from you.
dog.name: Emilio Pooch
